name: programbench
description: ProgramBench (Meta FAIR): 201 program-reconstruction tasks converted by BenchFlow from facebookresearch/programbench 2803dcc, as first published here (2026-05-14). Unchanged. 1.0 does not produce scores on any BenchFlow release; use 1.1.

name: programbench
description: ProgramBench 1.0's tasks with a verifier allowlist (huggingface.co, cas-server.xethub.hf.co, us.gcp.cdn.hf.co, us.aws.cdn.hf.co, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org) and pytest-timeout pinned. Hidden tests that are missing or never report end unscored, never as a silent 0; test cases that reach the internet through the program under test aren't counted, and tasks left with nothing countable are left out. Needs a BenchFlow release that enforces a task's verifier network allowlist.
